about: Hooptrax history archive. ESPN-verified: career totals (live through 2026-27 for active players), single-season leaders since 1975-76 (ESPN season data), player awards (checked against each player's ESPN award record; 'verified': false marks the few ESPN could not confirm), Finals MVPs, #1 picks and draft steals (checked against ESPN draft records), and 2026 results read from ESPN. Editorial (not verifiable from a reachable feed): Coach of the Year, retired numbers and years (audited Nov 2026 against team announcements, incl. upcoming ceremonies), franchise top-5 leaders (names only), pre-1974 rebound totals (official NBA figures), lottery notes and pre-1975 single-season records. Edit freely.
